evidence: Compares the first 16 bytes of x0 and x1; when equal, decrements the 32-bit counter at x1+0x144 and clears x1+0x140 when the count reaches zero. If the resource pointer/flag at x1+0x150+0x91 is set, it looks up the player resource entry and conditionally invokes a follow-up helper. Caller main_0076.c:31421-31424 loads the current global resource and x19+0x120 into the two arguments while initializing that object. This supports the reference-count/release behavior; the counter's exact field meaning is not inferred.

When x0 is non-null, the body saves x2-x7 and vector arguments into a stack varargs area, passes that area in x2, and calls parse_http_cookie_header (0x7001a81854); when x0 is null it returns 43. Its caller supplies event-like numeric selectors and optional values (main_0151.c:14394-14406). The label describes the forwarding wrapper and its named callee without asserting what the selectors mean.

The full body first checks attribute status key 0x13 via check_attribute_status_19_equals_4, then branches through two helpers and global values at 0x7003aeb728 and 0x7003ab5f40 before returning a boolean. Caller main_0012.c:9695-9697 consumes the result as a predicate in a numeric/vector calculation, but the relationship among the alternate branches and global values is not established, so keep the function unnamed.

Stores a pointer derived from global 0x7002295578 into the input object, clears global 0x7003b02628, calls the accepted write_audio_memory_map_dump helper (0x70003e2c90), then initializes several input-object slots and returns a pointer via f_70003d4138. The small wrapper caller invokes this routine and returns after it (main_0093.c:42623-42634). The name captures the clearly observed dump and context setup/reset behavior.

Resolves a record candidate (including a global default path), obtains an associated pointer through the object's +0x38 field, and returns whether the low 64-bit word at that pointer has no bits in mask 0xc000000000. Caller main_0113.c:6708-6710 stores the result as a boolean-like value among other record-derived attributes. The name limits the claim to the observed mask check; the record's domain meaning is unknown.
